title: Record provenance and licensing for seed content
user_visible_behavior: Every exercise and programming record carries a source and license/attribution field, and content without a permitted status cannot be published.
verification: Inspect seeded records and confirm each has source and license/attribution metadata.
Attempt to publish a record marked unlicensed and confirm it is blocked.
Run the content validation check and confirm it fails on missing provenance.
evidence: Policy helpers in `src/modules/content/domain/provenance.ts`: `PUBLISHABLE_LICENSE_STATUSES` = `['owned','permitted']`, `PublishableLicenseStatus`, `LICENSE_STATUSES_BY_PROVENANCE_KIND` (the single kind/status table), `isLicenseStatusAllowedForKind`, `isPublishableProvenance`, `requiresAttribution` (`licenseStatus === 'permitted' || kind === 'cmd-mora'`). Schema messages and unit tests both derive from these helpers.

Parser gate in `src/modules/content/domain/content-package.ts` (extends the existing `superRefine`): R1 published ⇒ `owned`/`permitted`, R2 published permission-dependent ⇒ `attribution`, R3 kind/status compatibility for every record including drafts, plus `z.strictObject(shape, { error })` on `provenanceSchema` for a clear missing-provenance message.

In-memory clone probes on the shipped package (no file edits): untouched package parses; `exercises.0.provenance.licenseStatus: Published content requires licenseStatus "owned" or "permitted"; "unlicensed" cannot be published.`; `programming.0.provenance.licenseStatus: ..."pending" cannot be published.`; `exercises.0.provenance: Provenance is required on every Exercise and Programming record.` (same at `programming.0.provenance`); `exercises.0.provenance.attribution: Published content with licenseStatus "permitted" requires an attribution naming the credited source.`; `exercises.1.provenance.licenseStatus: License status "owned" is not allowed for kind "reference"; use "reference-only" or "pending".`; `programming.0.provenance.licenseStatus: License status "owned" is not allowed for kind "cmd-mora"; use "permitted".`; a draft record with `reference`/`pending` still parses, and the same permitted exercise parses once `attribution` is present.
